description:
Everything the index knows about one vendor: category, areas, bookability score, website, how to book,
and every published fact (starting price and what it covers, packages, deposit, booking lead time,
cancellation policy and more), each with the quote from the vendor's own site, its page and the date read.
If a name matches several vendors, the error lists them with their index_page. (fetch returns the same facts
as text, for ids that came from search.)

vendor.description: The vendor's name (or part of it), its index_page URL from another tool, or its slug such as "448-studio".
vendor.title: Vendor

name: get_vendor

contact_methods.description: Ways to reach the vendor shown on its site (form, email, phone...).
contact_methods.title: Contact Methods

instant_quote.description: The site shows a price after choosing options.
instant_quote.title: Instant Quote

online_booking.description: The vendor's site lets you book online.
online_booking.title: Online Booking

quote_request_form.description: The site has a form to ask for a quote.
quote_request_form.title: Quote Request Form

shows_open_dates.description: The site shows dates that are still open.
shows_open_dates.title: Shows Open Dates

quote.description: The words on that page (emails and phones masked).
quote.title: Quote

source.description: The vendor's own page the fact was read from.
source.title: Source

value.description: The value as recorded (text, number, list or object).
value.title: Value

cite_as.default: Agent Bookability Index by The Runup (index.therunup.ai)
cite_as.title: Cite As

facts.description: Every published fact, by name (starting_price, packages, deposit...).
facts.title: Facts

title: Get one vendor
